name: metrics-pull
description: Pulls fresh numbers from a spreadsheet you name (title or link, optional tab and range) or from a table you paste, and returns them as a clean table: the columns you ask for, filters, grouping and simple aggregates (sum, average, min, max, count, latest) and period-over-period comparisons, all computed in code, with an as-of time and the source range on every answer. Say "as json" for a JSON envelope a workflow step can read. It re-reads the sheet on every request, reports a missing column instead of guessing, never edits the sheet and never explains why numbers moved.

skills.name: Metrics pull
skills.description: Reads a spreadsheet (or a pasted table) and returns the requested columns, filters, groups, totals, latest values and period-over-period changes as a table with as-of time and source range; JSON on request.
examples: Latest weekly signups by region from KPI sheet
Total revenue by plan for October
Columns date, mrr, churn from 'Finance Weekly' as json
